story.label: STORY
story.body: In the Year 2117, prior to the aftermath of Earth's collapse, survivors initiated the Hyper Tek Exodus. Humanity's final endeavour for survival didn't result in the conquest of the stars; instead, it scattered across them, dispersing AI, enhanced genomes, and prototypes over thousands of seed worlds. Eons passed, as each world developed in isolation, giving rise to new species, cultures, and technologies. At the heart of it all lies the Echo Core, a quantum relic pulsing with paradoxes, memories, and a call to power. It awakens you as a reborn Overlord, forged from legacy and technology.

about.title: The year is 2117.
about.body: Humanity didn't conquer the stars—it fractured into them. After Earth's collapse, survivors launched the Hyper Tek Exodus, scattering AI, enhanced genomes, and prototypes across thousands of seed worlds. Each evolved in isolation, forming new species, cultures, and technologies. At the center of it all lies the Echo Core, a quantum relic now pulsing with riddles, memories, and a call to power. It awakens you, a reborn Overlord, forged by legacy and technology.

packages.badge: LIMITED EDITION NFAs AND GAMING PACKAGES, AVAILABLE WHILE SUPPLY LASTS
packages.intro1: Hyper Tek 100 is a gaming project in development that sets out to tackle some of the industry's most pressing challenges. The website, marketplace and item system are built, and three interconnected games are planned. Ahead of the games, we are releasing a limited number of items and packages for players and collectors who want to join the universe early.
packages.intro2: We are releasing a small number of Stage 1 Non-Fungible Asset (NFA) items. Each lists in-game bonuses that may apply if the games are released, and the Stage 1 bonus levels are not planned to be repeated. Supply is hard-capped: once these items sell out, any remaining unminted limited-edition NFAs will be removed from the website.
packages.intro3: Eligible Hyper Tek items carry a Programmatic Trade-In Value, held in an on-chain escrow. These limited edition NFAs also list in-game bonuses that may apply, subject to the final game rules, if the games are released.
packages.intro4: If you enjoy what you have seen of the Hyper Tek Project and would like to own one of these limited items, now is the time. Supply is capped, and once an item is gone it will not be minted again.
packages.intro5: Our second release is a set of exclusive gaming packages sold directly on our own website, at a 10% lower price than they may later be offered elsewhere. This price is available for a limited time only.
packages.intro6: Hyper Tek Non-Fungible Assets (HT NFAs) are digital collectibles with the largest in-game bonuses in the Hyper Tek range, which may apply if the games are released, plus a Programmatic Trade-In Value. Available only while supply lasts.
packages.intro7: Hyper Tek is built as Play-to-Own: the items you collect are yours, recorded on-chain, with in-game utility that may apply across the planned games. Items are sold as digital collectibles, not as a way to make money.
